# python-llm-universe-benchmark

Reproducible Python 3.11 LLM benchmark (offline, Docker, MIT): book NLP basics + tokenizer bias (3x) + sequential early-stop (68% saved) + IRT rho=1.0 + RAG 0→1 + multilingual gap 0.5 + judge kappa 0.7 + gates PASS. 24 tests, 88% coverage, seed 1337.

- Quickstart: pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install -e . && pytest -q && python scripts/run_all.py
- Docs: docs/ZERO_TO_HERO.md, docs/PHD_ROADMAP.md, docs/report.html
- License: MIT
